cheapestBookingWindow.summary: Within the Feb 15–Mar 23, 2027 window, late February (Feb 15–22 and Feb 22–Mar 1) is empirically the cheapest travel period in both Shanghai (30%–53% cheaper than March) and Beijing (2%–14% cheaper than mid-March). For booking lead time, lock in a free-cancellation rate 2–3 months ahead (Nov–Dec 2026) and re-check 7–14 days before arrival when KAYAK's May 2026 global hotel pricing data shows last-minute drops on non-event weeks.

bookingLeadTimeGuidance.sourceName: KAYAK Hotel Pricing Study (published May 6, 2026; analyzing Jan 2025–Mar 2026 search data)
keyFindings: Cheapest booking window statistically falls within 1–2 weeks before check-in (week of stay) on standard off-peak dates, though relying solely on last-minute inventory risks sell-outs during Beijing Two Sessions or Shanghai trade fairs.
Cheapest check-in days for international hotel stays are Sunday and Monday (Friday and Saturday check-ins carry the highest weekend premiums).

Actionable Two-Step Booking Playbook: (1) Reserve a Free Cancellation rate immediately (all 10 hotels below offer free cancellation up to 1–3 days before check-in) to lock in low February pricing; (2) Re-check Trip.com and official brand rates 14 days and 7 days prior to Feb 22, 2027—rebook if lower, or keep your locked-in rate if rates rise.
